title: Source Receipt v0.1
description: A vendor-neutral pin for one saved observation of one source. It records what was read, when, from where, and the exact bytes, so a stranger can re-check the file later. It does NOT assert that the content is correct — only that a saved file matches this pinned observation.

schema.description: Optional. When present it MUST equal the constant "source-receipt-1"; any other value is reported as invalid by the checker.

url.description: Direct source URL that was read.

retrievedAt.description: ISO-8601 instant the source was read.

publishedAt.description: ISO-8601 instant the source says it was published, when it says so.

sourceType.description: Required. The kind of source, for review triage.

contentSha256.description: Required. SHA-256 of the saved bytes as 64 hex characters. Case-INSENSITIVE: an uppercase digest is accepted and normalized to lowercase for comparison by the checker, which reports the normalization as integrity.pin.normalized. A value that is not 64 hex characters is an UNUSABLE PIN — the checker leaves integrity 'unknown' and reports the field invalid.

contentType.description: The label the saved file is claimed to have (e.g. application/pdf, text/csv, text/html). Used for the format check.

savedAs.description: Filename or path the bytes were saved to.

excerpt.description: At most 300 characters. Store an excerpt, never a full third-party text.

notes.description: Optional. When present it MUST be a string; any other type is reported as invalid by the checker.
